description: STeP Skill evaluation coverage baseline. Registration/routability is not the same as model-side usefulness.

requiredDimensions.positive: should trigger and produce the intended deliverable
requiredDimensions.antiTrigger: similar request that should not use this Skill
requiredDimensions.collision: request overlapping a neighboring Skill; Router must choose correctly
requiredDimensions.missingSource: when authoritative input is unavailable, expose the gap instead of inventing it

pilotToApproved: record explicit approval evidence; approval role alone is insufficient

note: Many skills in needsDirectModelSideCoverage already have routing/authority regression tests. This list means they are not directly represented in pilot-30-v1 model-side benchmark.
